Ai.name: AI assistant
Ai.subtitle: Explains what you don't understand and helps you work through a topic.
Ai.askQuestion: Go through it with the assistant
Ai.emptyBody: Ask about any study topic, or pick a question below.
Ai.tooLong: The message is too long: {max} characters at most.
Ai.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes, so check anything important. Faroz doesn't save this chat; Google Gemini processes it.
Ai.sugExplain: Explain a topic in simple words
Ai.sugPlan: Make a plan to improve a weak topic
Ai.sugQuiz: Ask me three questions to check myself
Ai.sugTeach1: How do I explain this topic to beginners?
Ai.sugTeach2: What mistakes do students make most often?
Ai.birthHint: Needed for the AI assistant (18+). Nobody else sees it.
Ai.birthWhy: The AI assistant is for people aged 18 and over. Enter your date of birth; nobody else will see it.
Ai.birthOnce: You can set this once. If you make a mistake, write to the Faroz team.
Ai.lockedTitle: The AI assistant is for people aged 18 and over
Ai.lockedUntil: It opens on {date}. We'll let you know when it does.
Ai.accountBody: The AI assistant works in a personal account. Sign up to use it.
Ai.unlockTitle: The AI assistant is open for you
Ai.unlockBody: It can now explain lessons and go through your mistakes.

err.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The assistant isn't connected yet. Try again later.
err.AI_BUSY: The assistant is overloaded right now. Try again a little later.
err.AI_BUDGET: The platform's assistant limit is used up. Try again later.
err.AI_BLOCKED: The assistant can't answer this. Try asking another way.
err.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Couldn't reach the assistant. Try again.
err.AI_BAD_RESPONSE: The assistant returned an incomplete result. Try again.
err.AI_DAILY_LIMIT: Today's limit is used up. It resets tomorrow.
err.AI_EXAM_ACTIVE: The assistant is off during a test. Finish the test and come back.
err.AI_UNDER_18: The AI assistant is for people aged 18 and over.
err.AI_NEEDS_BIRTH_DATE: Enter your date of birth in settings first.
err.AI_NOT_ELIGIBLE: The assistant isn't available for this profile.
err.AI_FILE_TYPE: This file type won't work. Upload a PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV or image.
err.AI_FILE_UNREADABLE: Couldn't read the file. It may be damaged or empty.
err.AI_FILE_TOO_LONG: The file has too much text. Upload part of it.
err.AI_NOTHING_TO_USE: Add a file or describe the topic.
err.AI_NO_TOPICS: This group's subject has no topics.

Ai.testBody: Upload material or describe what to check. The assistant prepares a draft, and you publish it.
Ai.topicBody: Describe the topic. The assistant prepares a draft lesson and test. Students don't see them until you've reviewed and published them.
Ai.placeholderTest: For example: arrays, map and filter, beginner level
Ai.placeholderTopic: For example: JavaScript closures for people who know functions
Ai.fileHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV or image, up to {max} MB. The file goes to Google Gemini and isn't kept in Faroz.
Ai.fileTooBig: The file is larger than {max} MB.
Ai.generating: The assistant is working. This can take a couple of minutes; no need to refresh.
Ai.doneBody: Check the questions, answers and text. AI can make mistakes, and only you can publish.
Ai.reviewWarning: AI wrote this text. Check the facts and examples before publishing.
Ai.publishBody: Students in group {group} will see it.
Ai.deleteBody: You won't be able to restore it.
